title: How to Remind Your Boss of Your PTO Without Pissing Them Off

claims.claim: Tatil talebini planlamak icin 4 ila 6 ay onceden istemek mumkundur.

evidence.quote: If you like to plan in advance, you might request time off four to six months out.

claims.claim: Izin baslangicindan 4 ila 6 hafta once tatil talebinde bulunmak uygun bir suredir.

evidence.quote: four to six weeks before your time off is probably about right.
If this conversation doesn't give you much clarity, four to six weeks before your time off is probably about right.

claims.claim: Tatilden yaklasik iki hafta once yoneticiye ve meslektaslara toplantilarda sozlu olarak hatirlatma yapilmalidir.

evidence.quote: About two weeks before your time off, remind your boss and colleagues verbally in meetings.

claims.claim: Departman disindaki kisilere planlanan izin yazili olarak bir hafta once bildirilmelidir.

evidence.quote: If you need to tell someone beyond your team—such as clients or another department—about your planned time off, do so in writing a week before you leave.

claims.claim: Izin baslamadan iki is gunu once,ikeylem gerektiren kisilere kisa ve net bir mesaj gonderilmelidir.

evidence.quote: Two business days before your time off begins, send a short, clear message to everyone who needs to know that you will be out.

claims.claim: Izin mesajindaki ikinci tarih, tatilin son gununu degil ise baslanacak tarihi gostermelidir.

evidence.quote: The second DATE is the day you return to work, not the last day of your PTO.

claims.claim: Izin baslamadan iki is gunu once gonderilecek mesaj Persembe gunu gonderilmelidir eger izin Pazartesi basliyorsa.

evidence.quote: If your first PTO day is Monday, you send this message on Thursday so that anybody who takes off or calls in sick on Friday still sees it in time.
Why send this message two business days out? Simple: If your first PTO day is Monday, you send this message on Thursday so that anybody who takes off or calls in sick on Friday still sees it in time.

claims.claim: Asiri unutkan yoneticiler ve is arkadaslari icin iznin ilk gunu saat 08:30 da otomatik bir mesaj ayarlanabilir.

evidence.quote: For those supremely forgetful bosses and coworkers, you might set up an automated message that appears at 8:30 am the first day you're out.
